message.chartalandlords.tooltip.bid: Bid to become the landlord - must beat the current highest bid
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.reveal: Reveal: show your hand to everyone and double your personal stake. Can be combined with Double for x4. Revealing cannot be undone
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.double: Double: double your personal stake, which only scales your own stake against the landlord; you can toggle it until you confirm
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.declare_: Confirm and end my decision; anything left off counts as x1
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.play: Play the cards selected in the play area (hotkey: Enter)
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.pass: Pass this turn (not allowed when you lead; hotkey: Space)
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.hint: Auto-select the smallest combination that beats the last play
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.retract: Return every selected card to your hand (right clicking anywhere also works)
message.chartalandlords.tooltip.tidy: Sort the whole hand by rank again and drop any manual order you dragged
message.chartalandlords.wrong_seat_count: Doudizhu needs %1$s seated entities (deck has %2$s cards)
message.chartalandlords.your_bid_turn: Your bid: you must beat the current highest bid
message.chartalandlords.bid_forced: Nobody bid twice, %1$s becomes the landlord
message.chartalandlords.bid_timeout: %1$s timed out and passes the bid
message.chartalandlords.grab_turn: %1$s may grab the landlord (%2$s grabs so far)
message.chartalandlords.your_grab_turn: Grab the landlord or not - each grab raises the multiplier
message.chartalandlords.declare_turn: Reveal / double: both switches can be on at once (x4 personal stake), auto-confirm after 10 seconds
message.chartalandlords.declare_prompt: Reveal shows your hand, Double raises the stake - you may pick both, then press Confirm
message.chartalandlords.declare_reveal: %1$s reveals! Hand is public, personal stake x%2$s
message.chartalandlords.declare_undouble: %1$s cancels the double, personal stake x%2$s
message.chartalandlords.your_turn: Your turn: click cards to select them, then press Play
message.chartalandlords.new_round: Everyone else passed, the last player leads again
message.chartalandlords.invalid_play_hin: That combination is invalid or too small; your selection is kept, just remove a card and retry
message.chartalandlords.bottom_appended: The bottom cards were appended to the end of your hand (you are using a manual order) - drag them where you want, or press Tidy
message.chartalandlords.hotkeys: Hotkeys: Enter play - Space pass - hand cards can be dragged to reorder
message.chartalandlords.hint_none: Nothing can beat the last play - you may pass
message.chartalandlords.counter.title: Tracker
message.chartalandlords.hand_view.title: Hands - every seat and the bottom cards
message.chartalandlords.hand_view.hint: Back button or ESC returns to the table - V also closes
message.chartalandlords.hint_cycle: Hint %1$s/%2$s (press again for the next one)
message.chartalandlords.game_interrupted: Game interrupted: a seated player left
message.chartalandlords.spring: Spring! %1$s never lost the lead - score doubled
message.chartalandlords.anti_spring: Anti-spring! The landlord played only one hand - score doubled
message.chartalandlords.score_line: Base %1$s - %2$s bombs - %3$s grabs - table multiplier x%4$s
message.chartalandlords.score_declares: %1$s player(s) revealed or doubled: personal multipliers only scale their own stake against the landlord
rule.chartalandlords.three_with_two.desc: When off, three of a kind can only be played alone (Pagat's two-deck variant has no triple-with-kicker)
rule.chartalandlords.four_with_two.descr: When off, four of a kind can only be played as a bomb
rule.chartalandlords.four_two_pair_kicke: Four with two may take a pair
On: 4444 + 55 is legal. Off: the two kickers must be different ranks
rule.chartalandlords.jokers_as_wing_pair: Off: 333 + small joker + big joker is illegal (Pagat forbids attaching both jokers)
rule.chartalandlords.scoring.description: Base = bid, doubled per bomb/rocket, doubled per grab, doubled again for spring and anti-spring
rule.chartalandlords.grab_landlord.descr: On by default. Bidding becomes one round of grab / no grab: each grab doubles the multiplier, the last grabber becomes the landlord, base stays 1. Turn it off for classic 1/2/3 bidding
rule.chartalandlords.declare_bonus.descr: After the landlord is decided everyone picks Reveal, Double or Skip once; each doubles that player's personal multiplier (reveal also makes the hand public)
rule.chartalandlords.ai_difficulty.descr: 0 = cautious (high bid bar, rarely bombs or grabs), 1 = balanced, 2 = aggressive (bids, grabs and reveals freely); style and urgency only, the rules never change
